facts.fact: 短信只有一句「我在这里」，此后一切平静
facts.anchor: I’m here. That’s all it said. Since then, nothing has happened.

facts.fact: 屋旁发现一只死羊被动物啃过，想埋但地冻得挖不动，第二天羊不见了
facts.anchor: I found a dead sheep near the house. Some animals had been at it.

facts.fact: 他盯着屏幕看了很久，三次重复「我在这里」，皮肤起鸡皮疙瘩
他猜想是 Benn 在逗他，还是 Arthur 仍在头顶电线里
facts.anchor: Was Dr Benn playing games with him? Or was Arthur still here, somehow, somewhere in the overhead wires?

facts.fact: 他亲口说出「Arthur 死了，和 Caroline 一起死在雪里」，话一出口便觉得真实
facts.anchor: Now that he’d spoken the words, they felt real. Arthur was dead.

facts.fact: 对 Caroline 他涌起一阵突然的、惊人的、绞痛般的悲伤
facts.anchor: he felt a sudden, startling, twist of grief

facts.fact: 查号台查到 Kirkhill 是一家养老院——Benn 是老人，也许有记忆问题
facts.anchor: So Kirkhill was a nursing home. That made sense: Benn was an old man.

facts.fact: 为了得到 Benn 回电，他谎称自己叫 Arthur
夜里窗下的狐狸用女人的声音尖叫，直到嘶哑地哀求
facts.anchor: until it grew hoarse with pleading
